description: Two-step resident soup train sft runs, one row per process, measured with benchmarks/harness/vram_estimate_calibration.py on an NVIDIA RTX PRO 5000 Blackwell (sm_120) under torch.cuda.set_per_process_memory_fraction(0.24). 'main' is the Soup commit the row ran on. 'setting' is how the k-bit run held its embeddings, norms and untied head: 'kbit_fp32' is PEFT's fp32 (every row on 527314a4, before #2683, and the auto_mixed_precision fp16 rows on 3f9ba5ce, run.auto_mixed_precision), 'bf16' is the #2683 default on a bf16 card (RunSpec.kbit_fp32 False). 'weights': 'pretrained' is the Hub checkpoint at 'revision'; 'random' is that revision's config.json initialised with torch.manual_seed(0) and saved in bf16 with the Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct tokenizer. See benchmarks/gate-int8-checkpointing-vram.md.
